payload.assumptions_validated: KILLER met - all five ranked unknowns are settled by evidence, none by argument, and none forced a design change. U1 the filtered merge mechanic: settled before the requirements gate (run-aa90b5a988e9) - two parents kept, tree filtered, evidence reachable through the tag, and the pattern composes across a second and third close without resurrecting withheld paths. U2 which root the milestone commit uses when the bless arrives from the board: settled by SP1 (run-af6e68ea06f7) - a trunk-rooted process commits onto the iteration's branch when it targets the worktree explicitly, so the owner's own bless channel behaves identically to the agent's. U3 committing into a worktree from a trunk-rooted process: settled by the same spike - three commits landed on the branch, trunk's HEAD never moved. U4 multi-commit branches: settled by SP2 - emptiness counted correctly, the filter held, and evidence from every milestone stayed reachable, not only the last. U5 the mid-merge crash window: not spiked by decision, because it is a known residue already recorded at the architecture gate and automated as fitness check FC5 rather than an open question.
payload.buildable: Buildable as evidenced, and more than that - the risky half is already demonstrated end to end against real git rather than reasoned about. Every mechanic the build needs has been executed at least once in a throwaway fixture: detect an empty branch, tag before merging, merge without committing, drop classified paths from index and worktree, commit with two parents, read withheld content back through the tag, and commit into a worktree from a foreign root. What remains for M7 is wiring those proven steps into the four elements and their refusal paths - no unproven mechanic sits on the critical path. The one honest caveat: nothing has yet been exercised against the REAL repository, only fixtures, which is exactly what the build's acceptance tests and the iteration's own close will do.
payload.results_recorded: Every spike's evidence is pinned by run reference rather than retyped: run-aa90b5a988e9 (the six-assumption filtered-merge probe), run-af6e68ea06f7 (SP1 milestone commits from a trunk-rooted process, plus SP2's multi-milestone close and per-milestone reachability), run-5c60fc098a24 (the follow-up that showed SP1's single apparent failure was a fixture missing the .worktrees ignore entry, not a design fault). Two promotions marked for entry into the build: P1 the root-resolution rule, which becomes E1 and E2's implementation directly - drive git with an explicit worktree target instead of trusting the caller's cwd; and P2 SP2's fixture shape, which becomes the M7 acceptance test's scaffold, entering pre-verified. The six fitness candidates FC1-FC6 carry forward as the checks the build must green, with FC3 and FC5 named as the two guarding the properties that matter most.
